verdict.rationale: dLocal documents a broad API for core operations: card and local payments, saving cards for recurring charges, wallet enrollments and cancellations, and status notifications. It also offers an MCP server bridging AI agents to its systems. However, nothing documents API parity with the dashboard, where users get credentials, track transactions, manage payment methods, access reports, and create no-integration payment links. No published OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of dashboard functions (reporting, payment-method management, payment links, credential management), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
